<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 14"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Orchard's Endurance](/Feats.aspx?ID=4293) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Stance" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=152" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 35

</column>

---

Patches of bark appear on the skin of you and your nearby allies. You and your allies in your kinetic aura gain resistance 5 to bludgeoning and piercing damage. In addition, you and your affected allies roll flat checks to recover from [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) twice and take the higher result; this is a [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76) effect.

---
**Level (+4)** The resistance increases by 2.
name: Orchard's Endurance
